headline.family_guess: Playfair Display / serif italic (script-y for emphasis words)
headline.weight: 600-700 for emphasis words, 400 for body serif line
headline.size_rel: 0.06-0.09 of frame height per line, emphasis words ~1.3x body size

caption.family_guess: same serif family throughout — no separate sans caption font

layout.host_pos: n/a — one static circular headshot photo (Derek Sivers) used as a citation card only, not a talking host
layout.safe_zones: generous top/bottom margin (~15% each), all text vertically centered in middle third
layout.caption_pos: center, stacked 1-3 short lines, no lower-third bar

transitions: text fade/scale-in per word or per line

themeable: accent/accent2 hue (teal can be swapped for channel brand color)
icon set (silhouette figure, coin, funnel/triangle, phone mockup, checklist, momentum-cradle, chess piece)
background stays neutral cream vignette — do not themify to dark, it's core to the look
